youtube_title: Mouth Ulcer Making Food Painful? Quick Fix | Body Fix #26 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #26. A mouth ulcer, and every bite STINGS?
B is right. A warm SALT WATER rinse. Keep it clean, don't poke it.
Often from biting your cheek, stress or hard brushing. Usually heals in 1-2 weeks.
Fix: Soft brush, avoid spicy, sour and hard food, use a straw if needed.
Red flags: Lasts over 3 WEEKS, keeps returning, or a painless red/white patch? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Mouth ulcers
